sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Tavra

lines.text: Harappa above, Mohenjodaro below. Walk the road or ask for the tram. Neither city is going anywhere.
Both platforms have a place to sit. The keeper at the southern landing will tell you about the boat.
You have looked long enough to see what we were trying to keep. That changes the conversation.
